script.title: Yub-Nub 497: Treetop Tracking Station
script.description: Forest engineers discover Classic Space: blue-and-amber treetop observatories, a timber-wing Galaxy Glider, a plank skybridge, radar crown and hooded astronauts. Lift-off roofs reveal the tracking consoles.
